basic_info.description: Located in Jordan Park, known for its flat, wide streets & beautiful properties on large lots, this impressive, grand-scale, turn-key, 2-lvl home-like condo is a must see for anyone seeking a home! Ultra-modern inside w/ sophisticated finishes, at almost 3,700 sq ft, you'll be in awe of the lrg windows & skylights flooding the space w/ natural light, the high ceilings & west views for gorgeous sunsets. The main lvl is an open plan w/ the fireplace btw the liv rm & din rm, enjoying its warmth from both sides. The din rm is open to the sleek kit w/ abundant custom cabinets keeping counters clear. A highlight is the media rm w/ very large tv, where all like to gather. Sunrm w/ deck is a delight, can be used for office or extra guests. A guestrm & its full, renovated bthrm are off the hall. A full-size laundry rm w/ large machines, cabinets & storage are conveniently located. A beautiful powder rm completes this lvl. The upper lvl has the rarely found 4-bd floor plan & includes an exceptional primary suite & 2 bthrms. The huge deck allows for fluid indoor/outdoor flow. Easy garage parking for one car w/ lots of storage. There is also a shared garden w/ patio. Fabulous location in a prestigious neighborhood, close to Laurel Village & Sacramento St. amenities, the Presidio, & the JCC.
